messages.subject: cut() function from WinBugs in Nimble
parts:
Dear Sir/Madam, 

I am currently using a spatial model in WinBugs which I would like to implement in Nimble. My model contains the cut() function. When I try to run my model in Nimble, this cut function does not work. 

Do you know if there is any other function doing the same job in Nimble as cut() in WinBugs? 

Kind regards, 
Oana Petrof

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: cut() function from WinBugs in Nimble
parts:
Hi Oana,

We have not implemented cut() functionality, in part because it's not actually justified statistically. Please see this link below for discussion of this and for how to do what you might need using multiple imputation:

https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11222-014-9503-z.pdf

-chris
